old_problem: Link enumeration was ignored in favor of link0, IOD and CCD evidence was not separated, timeout was undefined, and dmesg could not serve the listed Windows path.
disposition_reason: The correctable intent, two required locations and command family are explicit. ED-03 permits enumerated link IDs, supported package revision, timeout and OS-specific signatures as approved runtime bindings; ED-16 requires a dedicated SUT and one-shot operator execution. Separating IOD and CCD checkpoints and refusing a universal link0 completes the review without fabricating topology.
decision_basis: Read Reliability row 38, DeepSeek fields, historical record 2441 and next pending row 39.
Preserved independent IOD and CCD CE coverage.
Made `--listgmilinks` output and project topology authoritative instead of link0.
Defined Linux MCA/APEI/dmesg and Windows WHEA as alternative OS-native evidence paths.
No BIOS/HDT change, AMD tool execution or injection occurred.

test_case.test_name: GMI3 correctable error at IOD and CCD origins
test_case.purpose: Prove one approved correctable GMI3 event at each IOD and CCD origin on every in-scope physical link, with attributable OS evidence and unchanged fabric health.
required_package: CPU/platform GMI link-to-IOD/CCD topology and coverage rule
AMD tool/spec version, hash, license and parameter contract
Signed CE timeout and Linux/Windows location-specific signatures
BIOS FFE deviation and HDT authorization
OOB abort, fabric-health recovery and complete restoration
test_case.test_command: Capture `--listgmilinks` and bind each approved physical link; under qualified FAE control, execute exactly one signed errortype=0/linktraffic=1 IOD checkpoint and one CCD checkpoint. Preserve full transcripts, correlate each with its OS-native CE signature and link health, collect applicable management evidence, close the injector and restore BIOS/HDT state.
test_case.expected_result: Each required IOD and CCD checkpoint reports tool PASS and the correct location-specific CE within the approved timeout; no UCE, sync flood, reset, link degradation or residual configuration remains.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires topology-proven link targets, separate IOD/CCD transcripts, expected CE signature in the active OS, healthy GMI fabric and verified restoration. Fixed link0 without mapping, one generic corrected log, missing timeout or severity escalation fails.
safety_gate: Isolated SUT, independent console and licensed approved package.
One mapped origin at a time with signed CE semantics and aborts.
Stop on wrong link/location, UCE, storm, sync flood, reset, hang or degraded fabric.
No automatic retry; close HDT/injector and preserve evidence.
expected_evidence: Identity, topology map and link enumeration
Separate IOD and CCD command transcripts
Linux MCA/APEI/dmesg or Windows WHEA location signatures
Fabric health, optional management evidence, restoration and verdict
test_case.recovery: On any wrong-origin or severity event, halt the sequence, retain OOB/tool/OS evidence, apply only the approved fabric/platform recovery, close the injector and restore every BIOS/HDT delta before further authorization.

source_conflict.reason: Live topology replaces link0, IOD/CCD checkpoints are independent and each OS has an explicit timed oracle.
